title: Rare wildlife finds a haven in Bicol Natural Park

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A critically endangered kingfisher and several threatened and endemic wildlife species were recorded in Bicol Natural Park during biodiversity monitoring conducted in the second semester of 2026, according to the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) in Bicol. The monitoring, conducted through the Provincial Environment and Natural Resources Office in Camarines Norte and the Bicol Natural Park Protected Area Management Office, documented birds, mammals, reptiles, amphibians and insects across the protected area. Among the notable sightings was the critically endangered Northern Indigo-banded Kingfisher (Ceyx cyanopectus), which is listed under DENR Administrative Order No. 2019-09.
